data.contenido:
Menye nusi dzɔ va yi la ŋuti nya vavã ɖeɖekoe Biblia la gblɔ o, ke egblɔ nusi ava dzɔ le ɣeyiɣi, si gbɔna me la hã ɖi. Amegbetɔwo mate ŋu agblɔ nusi ava dzɔ la ɖi o. Ema tae míenya be Biblia la tso Mawu gbɔ. Nukae Biblia la gblɔ le ɣeyiɣi, si gbɔna ŋu?

Eƒo nu tso Mawu ƒe aʋawɔwɔ gã aɖe ŋuti. Le aʋawɔwɔ sia me la, Mawu aɖe vɔ̃ɖivɔ̃ɖi kple ame vɔ̃ɖiwo katã ɖa le anyigba dzi; gake akpɔ amesiwo subɔnɛ la ta. Mawu ƒe fia, Yesu Kristo, akpɔ egbɔ be Mawu subɔlawo nase vivi le ŋutifafa kple dzidzɔkpɔkpɔ me; eye be womagalé dɔ alo aku akpɔ gbeɖe o.

Ðe mele be míakpɔ dzidzɔ be Mawu awɔ paradiso yeye ɖe anyigba dzi oa? Gake ne míedi be míanɔ paradiso sia me la, ele be míawɔ nane. Le agbalẽa ƒe ŋutinya mamlɛtɔ me la, míasrɔ̃ nusi wòle be míawɔ be míase vivi le nukunu, siwo Mawu dzra ɖo ɖi na amesiwo subɔnɛ me la. Eyata xlẽ Akpa ENYILIA be nànya nusi Biblia la gblɔ ɖi na ɣeyiɣi, si gbɔna la.

data.titulo: Vɔ̃ɖinyenye Ðe Sia Ðe Ƒe Nuwuwu
data.contenido:
NUKA kpɔm nèle le afisia? Aʋakɔ, si le sɔ ɣiwo dzi. Gake kpɔ afisi wodo tso gbɔna la ɖa. Sɔawo le du dzi le alilikpowo dzi tso dziƒo! Ðe sɔwo le dziƒo vavãa?

Ao, menye sɔ ŋutɔŋutɔwoe nye esia o. Míenya, elabena sɔwo mate ŋu aƒu du le alilikpowo dzi o. Gake Biblia la gblɔ be sɔwo le dziƒo. Ènya nusitaea?

Elabena ɣeaɖeɣi, si va yi la, wozã sɔwo zi geɖe le aʋawɔwɔ me. Eyata Biblia la gblɔ be amewo le sɔ dom tso dziƒo be wòatsɔ afia be Mawu le aʋa wɔ ge kple amewo le anyigba dzi. Ènya alesi woyɔna na teƒe, si woawɔ aʋa sia lea? Harmagedon. Aʋa ma atsrɔ̃ vɔ̃ɖinyenye ɖesiaɖe ɖa le anyigba dzi.

Yesue anɔ ŋgɔ le Harmagedon-ʋa sia wɔwɔ me. Ðo ŋku edzi be Yesue nye Amesi Yehowa tia be wòanye Yeƒe dziɖuɖu la ƒe Fia. Ema tae Yesu ɖɔ fiakuku ɖo. Eye yi la fia be atsrɔ̃ Mawu ƒe futɔwo katã. Ðe wòle be wòawɔ nuku na mí be Mawu atsrɔ̃ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo katã?

Trɔ yi megbe nàkpɔ Ŋutinya 10 lia ɖa. Nukae nèkpɔ le afima? Tsiɖɔɖɔ gã, si tsrɔ̃ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo lae. Amekae he Tsiɖɔɖɔa vɛ? Yehowa Mawue. Azɔ kpɔ Ŋutinya 15 lia ɖa. Nukae le dzɔdzɔm le afima? Dzo, si tso Yehowa gbɔ la le Sodom kple Gomora tsrɔ̃m.

Trɔ yi Ŋutinya 33. Kpɔ nusi le dzɔdzɔm ɖe Egiptetɔwo ƒe sɔwo kple aʋatasiaɖamwo dzi la ɖa. Amekae na tsi la nyẽ tsyɔ wo dzi? Yehowae. Ewɔ esia be wòatsɔ akpɔ eƒe amewo tae. Kpɔ Ŋutinya 76 lia ɖa. Àkpɔ be Yehowa na wotsrɔ̃ eƒe dukɔ, Israel-viwo kura gɔ̃ hã le woƒe nuvɔ̃wɔwɔ ta.

Eyata mele be wòawɔ nuku na mí o be Yehowa adɔ eƒe dziƒoʋakɔwo be woahe vɔ̃ɖinyenye ɖesiaɖe ava nuwuwui le anyigba dzi. Gake bu tame le nusi ema anye ŋuti kpɔ! Ʋu axa, si kplɔe ɖo la ne míakpɔe ɖa.Nyaɖeɖefia 16:16; 19:11-16. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

LOOK at those tall trees, pretty flowers and high mountains. Isn’t it beautiful here? See how the deer is eating out of the little boy’s hand. And look at the lions and the horses standing over there in the meadow. Wouldn’t you like to live in a house in a place like this?

God wants you to live forever on earth in a paradise. And he doesn’t want you to have any of the aches and pains that people suffer today. This is the Bible’s promise to those who will live in the new paradise: ‘God will be with them. There will be no more death or crying or pain. The old things have passed away.’ Jesus will see to it that this wonderful change takes place. Do you know when? Yes, after he cleans the earth of all badness and bad people. Remember, when Jesus was on earth he healed people of all kinds of sicknesses, and he even raised people from the dead. Jesus did this to show what he would do all over the earth when he became King of God’s kingdom.

Just think how wonderful it will be in the new paradise on earth! Jesus, along with some of those whom he chooses, will be ruling in heaven. These rulers will take care of everyone on earth and see that they are happy. Let’s see what we need to do to make sure that God will give us everlasting life in his new paradise.Nyaɖeɖefia 21:3, 4; 5:9, 10; 14:1-3. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo

data.titulo: Ale Si Míawɔ Anɔ Agbe Tegbee
data.contenido:
ÈNYA agbalẽ, si xlẽm nyɔnuvi sue la kple exɔlɔ̃wo lea? Ẽ, agbalẽ si tututu xlẽm nèle fifia lae—Nye Agbalẽ si Nye Biblia Ŋutinyawo. Woawo hã wole ŋutinya, si xlẽm nèle fifia la xlẽm—“Alesi Míawɔ Anɔ Agbe Tegbee.”

Ènya nusi srɔ̃m wolea? Gbãtɔe nye be hafi míanɔ agbe tegbee la, ele be míanya nu tso Yehowa kple Via Yesu ŋuti. Biblia la gblɔ be: ‘Esiae nye agbe mavɔ ƒe mɔ la. Be nàsrɔ̃ nu le Mawu vavã ɖeka la kple Via, Yesu Kristo, si wòdɔ ɖo ɖe anyigba dzi la ŋuti.’

Aleke míawɔ asrɔ̃ nu le Yehowa Mawu kple Via Yesu ŋuti? Mɔ ɖekae nye be míaxlẽ Nye Agbalẽ si Nye Biblia Ŋutinyawo tso gɔmedzedzea vaseɖe nuwuwu. Eƒo nu geɖe tso Yehowa kple Yesu ŋuti, alo mele eme oa? Egaƒo nu geɖe tso nusiwo wowɔ kple nusiwo wogale wɔwɔ ge la ŋuti. Gake ehiã be míawɔ nu geɖe wu agbalẽ siawo xexlẽ ko.

Èkpɔ agbalẽ bubu, si le anyigba la? Biblia lae. Na ame aɖe naxlẽ Biblia la ƒe akpa, siwo me woɖe agbalẽ sia ƒe ŋutinyawo le la na wò. Biblia la gblɔ nusiwo katã hiã na mí be míate ŋu asubɔ Yehowa le mɔ nyuitɔ nu ahakpɔ agbe mavɔ la na mí. Eyata ele be míaɖoe be míasrɔ̃ Biblia la edziedzi.

Gake nusɔsrɔ̃ le Yehowa Mawu kple Yesu Kristo ŋu ɖeɖe mesɔ gbɔ o. Míate ŋu asrɔ̃ nu geɖe tso woawo kple woƒe nufiafiawo ŋuti, gake míakpɔ agbe mavɔ o. Ènya nu bubu si gahiã?

Ehiã hã be míaƒe agbenɔnɔ nasɔ kple nusiwo míesrɔ̃na la. Èɖo ŋku Yuda Iskariot dzia? Enye ame 12, siwo Yesu tia be woanye yeƒe apostolowo la dometɔ ɖeka. Yuda nya nu geɖe tso Yehowa kple Yesu ŋu. Gake nukae dzɔ ɖe edzi? Eva zu ɖokuitɔdila emegbe, eye wòde Yesu asi na eƒe futɔwo hexɔ klosalo 30. Eyata Yuda makpɔ agbe mavɔ o.

Èɖo ŋku Gexazi, ŋutsu si ŋu míesrɔ̃ nu le le Ŋutinya 69 me la dzia? Edi be avɔ kple ga, siwo menye etɔ o la nasu ye si. Eyata eda alakpa tsɔ xɔ nusiawoe. Gake Yehowa he to nɛ. Nenema kee ne míeɖo to eƒe sewo o la, ahe to na míawo hã.

Gake ame nyui geɖe li, siwo subɔ Yehowa le nuteƒewɔwɔ me. Ðe míedi be míanɔ abe woawo ene oa? Ðevi sue Samuel nye kpɔɖeŋu nyui aɖe, si yome míadze. Ðo ŋku edzi be abe alesi míekpɔe le Ŋutinya 55 mee ene la, exɔ abe ƒe ene alo atɔ̃ ko ene esime wòdze Yehowa subɔsubɔ gɔme le eƒe agbadɔ me. Eyata aleke nèganye ɖevie hã la, mèle sue akpa be màte ŋu asubɔ Yehowa o.

Gake amesi mí katã míedi be míasrɔ̃ lae nye Yesu Kristo. Esi wònye ŋutsuvi sue gɔ̃ hã abe alesi wòle Ŋutinya 87 mee ene la, eyi gbedoxɔ la me heƒo nu na ame bubuwo tso Fofoa, si le dziƒo la ŋuti. Mina míadze eƒe kpɔɖeŋu la yome. Mina míagblɔ míaƒe nuku Mawu, Yehowa kple Via Yesu Kristo ŋutinya na ame geɖe, si míate ŋui la. Ne míewɔ nusiawo la, ekema míate ŋu anɔ agbe tegbee le Mawu ƒe paradiso yeyea me le anyigba dzi.Yohanes 17:3; Psalmo 145:1-21. Nusɔsrɔ̃ Nyabiabiawo
